comment: C-first form correction from monsters.h: a barbed devil is a demon whose attack array begins AT_CLAW/AD_PHYS, so a bare-claw hit reaches damageum (unlike the Pit Fiend weapon attack). Stop at the source-observed target map before selecting a direction. The C map places the iron-golem apostrophe one square north of the Barbed Devil, so this recorded continuation attacks with direction k. This continuation dismisses the source-observed combat pager and makes one more C-map-confirmed northward attack to re-enter damageum. From the C trace, an attack can display several successive More pages for two claws, sting, and the target turn. Three spaces clear the observed page sequence before the next source-observed northward attack; preserve the exact transcript.
